items.t: Pre-catalytic converter breaks apart and damages the engine
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold with built-in pre-cats
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,326-$1,401. If debris has already damaged the engine, one owner was quoted about $5,400 for a new short block.

items.t: Heavy oil consumption
items.job: Replace short block (engine) or install a used engine
items.note: A dealer quoted one owner about $5,400 for a short block. Used engines are easy to find and cost less. Mild oil use only needs regular top-ups.

items.t: SMT stalls, lurches or misshifts
items.job: Repair SMT hydraulic line, pump or actuator, or replace SMT control unit
items.note: A corroded hydraulic line is the low end. One owner was quoted about $6,600 for a new SMT computer; a used transmission or parts often cost less.

items.t: SMT warning light, buzzing, or gears won't change
items.job: Replace SMT reservoir seal rings, refill and bleed fluid (T-SB-0031-18)
items.note: The bulletin uses two seal rings and about 3.5 quarts of SMT fluid. If the pump or actuator has failed, see the SMT repair item.

items.t: Timing chain wear or variable valve timing fault (P1349)
items.job: Replace VVT oil control valve (timing chain tensioner if worn)
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $367-$378 for the valve. RepairPal lists $252-$480 for a chain tensioner. A full timing chain job costs more.

items.t: Manual transmission slips out of gear or shifter feels loose
items.job: Inspect shift linkage and re-torque shift bracket bolts
items.note: If the gears inside the transmission are worn, a rebuild or used transmission costs far more.

items.t: Worn, torn or broken convertible top
items.job: Replace soft top with glass rear window
items.note: An aftermarket top sells for about $940-$1,260 and takes about 10 hours to fit. Shops quoted one owner about $1,900 installed.

items.t: Water inside from clogged convertible top drains
items.job: Clear top drain valves and dry carpet
items.note: Rust repair under the carpet costs extra.

items.t: Parking brake cable or rear caliper sticking
items.job: Replace parking brake cable
items.note: RepairPal lists about $492-$651. Seized rear calipers cost extra.

items.t: Oxygen sensor failure
items.job: Replace oxygen sensor
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $356-$480; RepairPal lists about $483-$707. Price depends on which of the three sensors failed.

items.t: SMT selects third gear instead of second (P0780)
items.job: Diagnose SMT and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Harsh shifts with the SMT
items.job: Check SMT fluid and perform harsh-shift bulletin

items.t: Rattle from loose exhaust heat shields
items.job: Diagnose noise and clamp or refasten heat shield

items.t: Squeal or rattle when slowing down after a cold start
items.job: Diagnose noise and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Check engine light for random misfire (P0300)
items.job: Replace spark plugs and ignition coils as needed
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $998-$1,150 for all four coils; often only plugs or one coil are needed.

items.t: Check engine light and lean running in freezing weather
items.job: Diagnose lean codes and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Squeak from the front of the car
items.job: Find squeak and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Brake groan or squeak
items.job: Replace front or rear brake pads

items.t: Hard starting or rough idle after the battery is disconnected
items.job: Idle relearn and throttle body cleaning

items.t: Crankshaft sensor code (P0335) from a weak battery
items.job: Test and replace 12V battery
items.note: RepairPal lists about $262-$280 for a battery. If the sensor really is bad, YourMechanic estimates about $351-$360.

items.t: Hood is hard to open
items.job: Replace hood latch

items.t: Clicking noise from the brakes
items.job: Inspect brakes and replace pads with shims and clips
items.note: If the pads are fine, cleaning and lubricating the clips costs less.
